object_description: asymmetrical U-shaped volume with stepped rooftop houses
design_condition: The building aligns with the natural terrain in successive stages, spares the existing trees, responds to neighboring building fronts, and forms a sequence of courtyards, gardens, a pedestrian connection and a roof terrace.

positive.statement: The orthogonal U-shaped layout spares the group of trees while creating a gesture of entry at the center.

position.target: orthogonal U-shaped layout and central entry
position.rationale: U-shaped perimeter and central opening are clearly visible in the top view, with low-rise massing confirmed by elevations.

positive.statement: The two asymmetrical wings respond to the gap between neighboring fronts and open a perspective along the oblique axis.

position.rationale: Offset wings and diagonal visual corridor are legible in the asymmetric top-view footprint.

positive.statement: The secondary rooftop volumes produce a lively but not excessive silhouette and a welcome visual break for the rear buildings.

position.rationale: Stepped upper volumes are visible along the rear/right portion of the footprint and elevations.

positive.statement: The landscape concept creates a clear sequence of courtyards, a transverse pedestrian connection, a linear garden and a roof terrace.

position.target: courtyards, pedestrian connection, linear garden and roof terrace
position.rationale: Open sequences are inferred from the U-shaped voids, perimeter gaps and stepped roof surfaces.

positive.statement: The cross section aligns well with the natural terrain and modifies it little.

position.rationale: Low, terraced elevations suggest a building stepping across the terrain.

positive.statement: The section hierarchically distributes public, teaching and administrative areas in a clear volumetric arrangement.

position.target: hierarchical public, teaching and administrative areas
position.rationale: Interior hierarchy is not distinguishable; the anchor uses the central volumetric organization.

positive.statement: The project is characterized by great accuracy in taking account of the site's urban-planning and landscape data.

position.rationale: Broad site response is distributed across the stepped footprint and surrounding open edges.

negative.statement: The successive spatial layers generate an air gap and visual escape but somewhat weaken the center of the building.

position.rationale: Central void and separated spatial layers are visible within the U-shaped plan.

negative.statement: The typologies and spatial organization are schematic and less accomplished than the organization of the section.

position.rationale: Interior organization is not sampled distinctly; the marker represents the main building mass.

negative.statement: The interior of the attics lacks spatial structure.

position.rationale: Attic interiors are absent, so the estimate is placed beneath the visible stepped rooftop volumes.
